dedupe_keys.name: digsilent powerfactory power system analysis software

description: PowerFactory is DIgSILENT's commercial power system analysis software for transmission, distribution, industrial, generation, distributed generation and renewable networks. The product page read on 2026-09-26 lists a base package with load flow, short-circuit analysis, sensitivities, network model management, outage management, diagrams and data converters, and advanced functions for contingency analysis, quasi-dynamic simulation, network reduction, protection, arc flash, cable analysis, power quality and harmonics, connection request assessment, probabilistic analysis, reliability and restoration, optimal power flow, unit commitment and dispatch, state estimation, RMS stability, electromagnetic transients, small signal stability, scripting and automation, and interfaces. Coverage is any network a user models. Access is by commercial licence in several editions, with quotation and demo requests on the page; prices are not published. Caveats: models and data formats are proprietary, so studies are hard to share with people without a licence, and results depend on the network data a user or utility supplies. Simulation uses are power flow, contingency and cascading failure studies, reliability and restoration analysis for resilience, capacity planning of connections, and optimal dispatch. Related records: model-powerfactory-tools-tu-dresden is an open tool set that works with PowerFactory, and model-pandapower is an open power system analysis alternative.
